blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —Former president Rodrigo Duterte appears before the International Criminal Court (ICC) Trial Chamber III on Tuesday, October 13, 2026, for the fourth status conference in his crimes against humanity case. READ: ‘He might die in prison’: VP Sara hopes ICC expedites father’s trial His previous appearance was during the chamber’s third status conference on Sept. 16, 2026. Judges have also recently declared that Duterte is physically and mentally well and would be able to follow the proceedings and defend himself once he is put on trial starting next month.
